script.title: JOINING THE GYM
script.scene_zh: 健身房櫃台 · 入會諮詢
script.story_hook: One free spin class changes his whole decision.
script.intro_zh: 一堂免費的飛輪課，讓他當場下定決心。
script.welcome_en: Hello there, glad you dropped by! Today we're joining a gym.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，高興你來拜訪！今天我們要加入一間健身房。
script.outro: Deal made, spin shoes on! See you next episode, bye.
script.outro_zh: 談定啦，穿上飛輪鞋！下一集我們再見，拜拜。
script.practice_intro_en: It's repeat time — say every line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 到了跟讀時間——每句都跟著我說一遍。

script.youtube_title: 【💪健身房入會英文】「隨時都能取消」真的嗎？18句入會諮詢🎧聽完就敢簽💡｜🌱A2初級｜Gym Membership English
script.youtube_title_en: "Cancel Anytime?" — Joining a Gym and Trying a Free Spin Class
script.youtube_description:
想健身，卻擔心合約一綁就是整整一年？這集直接帶你走進健身房櫃台！跟著 Carl 詢問會員方案、免費試一堂飛輪課、確認能不能隨時取消，還能用學生證拿每月折扣。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢報名入會。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Afraid a gym contract will trap you for a whole year? This episode walks you straight to the front desk. Follow Carl as he compares membership plans, tries a free spin class, asks about cancelling anytime, and scores a monthly student discount — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💪健身房入會英文｜比較方案・免費試課・確認取消規則｜聽完就敢入會｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
想上健身房，卻擔心長期合約把人身綁住嗎？
月費、試課、取消規則，用英文要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進熱鬧的健身房櫃台，跟著 Carl 從詢問會員方案、免費試一堂飛輪課、了解隨時取消的政策，一路問到學生證優惠與置物櫃租金，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🏋️ 方案與內容：例如「Equipment floor, locker room, and one class monthly.」。
🚣 試課與取消：例如「Can I try a class before paying, though?」。
🎓 優惠與價格：例如「Show an ID and take ten dollars off monthly.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

想開始運動的那天，帶著這十八句直衝健身房櫃台！
script.thumbnail_action: signing up on a tablet at the gym desk

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I want to sign up for the gym.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ wɑn tə saɪn ʌp fɔr ðə dʒɪm/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想報名加入你們的健身房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Awesome! What kind of membership are you after?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsɔm wʌt kaɪnd ˈmɛmbərʃɪp ɑr ju ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！你想找哪一種會員方案？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Probably the basic one. What's included there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑbəbli ðə ˈbeɪsɪk wʌn wʌts ɪnˈkludid ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 大概是基本款吧。那裡面包括什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Equipment floor, locker room, and one class monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkwɪpmənt flɔr ˈlɑkər rum ənd wʌn klæs ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 器材區、置物間，還有每月一堂課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good. But do I have to sign a contract?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd bət du aɪ hæv tə saɪn ə ˈkɑntrækt/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯。但我一定要簽合約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, cancel anytime — just give us notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /nəʊp ˈkænsəl ˈɛniˌtaɪm dʒʌst ɡɪv ʌs ˈnoʊtəs/
dialogue.zh: 不用，隨時可取消——只要事先說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice! Can I try a class before paying, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs kæn aɪ traɪ ə klæs bɪˈfɔr ˈpeɪɪŋ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好！那付錢之前，能先試上一堂課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, today's spin class at five thirty is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr təˈdeɪz spɪn klæs ət faɪv ˈθɜrdi ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，今天五點半的飛輪課免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spin? I haven't done that since college, um…
dialogue.phonetic: /spɪn aɪ ˈhævənt dʌn ðæt sɪns ˈkɑlɪdʒ ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 飛輪？我大學以後就沒練過了，呃……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beginners love it — the trainer paces it slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈɡɪnərz lʌv ɪt ðə ˈtreɪnər ˈpeɪsɪt ɪt ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 新學員都很愛——教練會把節奏帶得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll try it. Do I bring my own shoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ aɪl traɪ ɪt du aɪ brɪŋ maɪ oʊn ʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我試試。要自備鞋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus a towel — lockers rent for a dollar.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ə ˈtaʊəl ˈlɑkərz rɛnt fɔr ə ˈdɑlər/
dialogue.zh: 要，還有一條毛巾——置物櫃一個一塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Oh wait, do you have student discounts?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul oʊ weɪt du ju hæv ˈstudənt ˈdɪskaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 好。喔，對了，學生有打折嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show an ID and take ten dollars off monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ən ˌaɪˈdi ænd teɪk tɛn ˈdɑlərz ɔf ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 出示學生證，每個月減十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That settles it then — I'll join starting today!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɛtəlz ɪt ðɛn aɪl dʒɔɪn ˈstɑrtɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就這麼決定了——我今天就要加入！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great call! Tap the tablet and read the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt kɔl tæp ðə ˈtæblət ænd rid ðə fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 好決定！點一下平板，先把表格讀一讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done already? That was quick, no paperwork even!
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɔlˈrɛdi ðæt wʌz kwɪk noʊ ˈpeɪpərwɛk ˈivən/
dialogue.zh: 就辦好了？好快喔，連文件都不用填！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome aboard! Your first workout starts at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm əˈbɔrd jɔr fɜrst ˈwɜrkˌaʊt stɑrts ət faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎加入！你的第一堂課五點開始。
